cards.b: Solana has set October 21 for its Alpenglow upgrade, which targets 150-millisecond finality and replaces the existing validator voting system.

per.SOL: The upgrade removes vote transactions from blocks and aims to improve finality speeds.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Market reaction and whether transaction counts will be artificially affected by vote removal.

cards.t: Binance Delisting of EPIC and QUICK
cards.b: Binance is set to delist EPIC and QUICK, ending spot trading on October 28, which immediately triggered double-digit price drops upon announcement.

per.QUICK: Fell as much as 20% following the announcement.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact time of spot trading cessation on October 28.

cards.b: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, secured approval to trade crypto and plans to open crypto trading to all clients on December 1.

per.BTC: Will be tradable via Sberbank's app once fully opened to all clients.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full regulatory scope and volume limits for retail clients.

cards.b: Strive is raising $500 million to buy additional bitcoin by issuing a new preferred share class offering a fixed 15% dividend yield.

per.BTC: Set to benefit from corporate treasury accumulation using the newly raised capital.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact date when the $500 million will be fully deployed to purchase Bitcoin.
